description: This PHP source file defines the SchemaHelper class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manipulate database schema via Doctrine DBAL, including adding, dropping, renaming columns, managing foreign keys, and creating tables.

classes.name: SchemaHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing and manipulating database schemas using Doctrine DBAL, supporting operations such as adding, dropping, and modifying columns, foreign keys, and tables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes SchemaHelper with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current database connection.

methods.name: dropColumn
methods.description: Drops a specified column from a table.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Drops multiple columns from a table.

methods.name: getTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves a specific column object from a table.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager instance.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to a table with specified options.

methods.name: addOrChangeColumns
methods.description: Adds or updates multiple columns on a table based on provided options.

methods.name: changeColumn
methods.description: Changes the definition of a column in a table.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Renames a column within a table.

methods.name: dropForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops specified foreign keys from a table.

methods.name: addForeignKey
methods.description: Adds a foreign key constraint to a table.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table object with specified charset, collation, and engine options.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database schema.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Drops the primary key of a table.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object.

methods.name: disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in the database.

methods.name: enableConstraints
methods.description: Enables foreign key checks in the database.

methods.name: columnExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a table.
